Detect noninjective distinct-token mappings and distinct scenario/output identity collisions. Repeating the same feature/client tag on multiple scenarios is intentional and must not be misclassified as a collision. Reuse portable output path collision checks.

Do not replace originals with imported destination paths, reconstructed hashes or unresolved IDs.
